Johnsy counts the falling leaves from her bed and keeps her face turned toward the window. The opening is anchored by <Picture 3> and preserves <Subject 1>, <Subject 2>.

detailed_description: The target video is a realistic live-action period drama in a vertical 9:16 frame, with restrained natural light, tactile period materials, and observational camera movement. The shot begins from <Picture 3>, with <Subject 2> lying on the narrow bed inside <Subject 1>. At 0.00 to 1.60 seconds her eyes remain fixed toward the window and she quietly starts counting. Johnsy (S1), a frail young woman with a soft breathy voice, says: <d>[Chinese] 五……</d> At 1.60 to 3.70 seconds wind crosses the window and one leaf drops in the background; her eyes follow the falling point without turning toward Sue. At 3.70 to 5.80 seconds she continues in the same low voice: <d>[Chinese] 四。</d> The camera makes only a very small slow push toward her profile and holds the accepted ending with four leaves behind her. The movement is one continuous take with no cut. No non-diegetic subtitles, captions, or dialogue text overlays appear at any moment. Continuity locks: pale ivory cotton nightdress; narrow top-floor artist studio with a tall rain-streaked window and exposed brick; final olive-green leaf on a wet brown vine.
overall_soundscape: Damp window room tone, a restrained gust against the glass, one faint leaf flutter, and Johnsy's quiet breath around the spoken count.
non_diegetic_music: N/A
